profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Sitecore
profile.summary: At Sitecore, I contribute to the OrderCloud platform which is a headless commerce solution that empowers businesses to build custom marketplaces and storefronts. As part of the company behind the leading digital experience platform, I focus on developing solutions that enhance commerce experiences, improve developer workflows, and solve complex technical challenges. My work bridges technical implementation with user experience, supporting Sitecore's broader mission of delivering flexible, enterprise-grade commerce solutions that adapt to evolving business needs.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description: Solving complex problems for commerce solutions through scalable architecture and optimized user experiences. Spearheading the development of internal tools and frameworks that enhance developer efficiency while maintaining performance and reliability across enterprise commerce platforms

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Built, managed, and deployed the OrderCloud documentation site with CI/CD, ensuring reliability and usability
- Contributed to the OrderCloud Portal, developing features, managing releases, and maintaining usability.
- Co-founded Blok Design System, establishing a scalable, cohesive UI framework for OrderCloud and other Sitecore products.

positions.title: UX/UI Developer
positions.description: Create data-driven digital experiences for key clients through user research, visual design, high-fidelity wireframing, prototyping, and frontend development. Client-facing role with a focus on both UX strategy and implementation.

positions.title: UX / UI Developer
positions.description:
I create environments of collaboration, mentorship, and opportunities for everyone to get involved and excited about our product design. I strive to be a design evangelist and encourage all developers to work towards impacting the presentation layer of our apps. I work to overdeliver superior design, level up others, and always push the work further.

One benefit of being a "full stack designer" is that I have the opportunity to identify and solve challenges at low fidelity, collaborate and polish solutions for delivery, along with implementing the solution directly. I consider myself to be a "designer raised by developers" which allows me the opportunity to not only work on user experience, user interface, user interaction, but the front end development as well.

I design and code on the company’s highest-priority projects, identify and drive outcomes and help shape the critical efforts by defining new processes that lead to better, more strongly aligned design outcomes.

In short, I am passionate about everything design at Four51.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
I assist in the design, coding, and testing of technical solutions while adhering to our technical methodology in order to effectively contribute to both client and platform projects. Being part of the agile design team at Four51 also means I am utilizing industry trends and developments in order to improve the quality and service for our clients as well as our internal product initiatives.

I consider myself a usability advocate who seeks to better understand our users’ needs as well as their limitations while simultaneously working to create visually stunning interfaces that elicit emotional connections with users and communicate the brand. Along technical development, I also continue to manage our corporate brand identity, assist in our marketing strategies, and optimize our public-facing websites. I love whiteboarding sessions, html prototyping, and firing up Figma to crank out workflows. Here are my specialties within my current role: HTML, CSS/LESS/SASS, Bootstrap, Adobe Suite, Figma, Github, Jira, Wordpress.

positions.title: Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
- Create key pieces of content including, blogs, email campaigns, social media posts, surveys, videos, podcasts, testimonials, case studies, data sheets, webinars, etc.
- Manage Four51 brand identity, design internal and external marketing collateral.
- Provide campaign direction and build strategies to further the business.
- Manage social media and email marketing platforms; create and evaluate strategies, develop new methods to engage consumers; grow the company’s reach.
- Use and analyze data and measurements to plan, report on and optimize content strategies, informing the marketing strategy at large.
- Serve as a sales liaison, attending sales meeting and using real-time feedback to further the editorial calendar.
- Use segment marketing tactics to become a specialist on each of our target markets.
- Manage customer success to ensure world-class customer service.

positions.title: Marketing Manager
positions.description:
- Manage content for 12 retail stores including airport, pop-up, and corporate retail
- Create in-store marketing materials and effective promotional calendars
- Develop on-point branded products and merchandise visuals
- Assist with business development and retail expansion opportunities

positions.title: Web Designer, Academic Services
positions.description:
Upon graduation, I was brought on to continue overseeing website management and creation for several departments (Office of Academic Services and Special Programs, Office of Global Initiatives, and Socio-Economic Approach to Management).

- Web Design
- Copywriting
- Graphic Design

positions.title: Student Worker, Institutional Review Board
positions.description:
The Institutional Review Board at St. Thomas reviews proposed research studies involving human participants in order to safeguard the rights, safety, and welfare of people involved in the research activities.

- Build, manage, and deploy IRB website.
- IRBnet administrator for submitted applications.
- Data research, handling and archiving historical IRB applications.

educations.schoolName: University of St. Thomas - Opus College of Business
